title: Separating Common and Unique Directions for Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2611.04108v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model merging combines multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, and arithmetic methods have emerged as a simple yet effective way to merge models without data. However, existing arithmetic methods treat task vectors in parameter space and apply a single element-wise rule to directions that can differ in mergeability. In a shared directional basis, we find a consistent two-regime structure: a low-dispersion common bulk shared across tasks and a high-dispersion task-dominated tail that carries disproportionate energy. These findings motivate Common--Unique Subspace Decomposition (CUSD), a data-free pre-merging method that separates task vectors into common and unique directional components, merges the common components with a downstream arithmetic operator, and retains unique residuals separately. translated_title: 面向模型合并的公共与独立方向分离
translated_abstract: 模型合并无需额外训练即可组合多个微调模型，而算术方法已成为一种无需数据、简单而有效的模型合并方式。然而，现有的算术方法在参数空间中处理任务向量，并对可合并性可能不同的方向统一应用单一的逐元素规则。在共享的方向基中，我们发现了一致的双区间结构：一个跨任务共享的低离散度公共主体，以及一个高离散度、由任务主导且承载着不成比例能量的尾部。这些发现催生了公共-独立子空间分解（CUSD），这是一种无需数据的预合并方法，它将任务向量分解为公共与独立的方向分量，用下游算术算子合并公共分量，并单独保留独立残差。在11个基础模型、四个模型家族和四种基于算术的合并算子上的实验表明，CUSD提升了……
tldr: 提出CUSD，一种无需数据的模型合并预处理方法，通过将任务向量分解为跨任务共享的公共方向分量和任务独有的独立分量并分别处理，从而提升算术合并方法的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes CUSD, a data-free pre-merging method that separates task vectors into shared common and task-specific unique directional components and processes them differently, improving performance of arithmetic-based model merging.
